noSiteDescription: Blind counts and replenishment suggestions always belong to one site.

errors.products: Unable to load stock-tracked products for this site.
errors.providers: Unable to load providers for this draft.

count.title: Blind inventory counts
count.description: Record physical quantities without seeing the expected balance, then review and approve every discrepancy.
count.blindDescription: Counters at {{site}} will see products and units, but not the frozen expected quantities until submission.
count.resultLimit: Showing the first {{count}} products. Refine the search to find the rest.
count.identityWorkflowRequired: Choose an individual variant or review incompatible tracking settings.
count.notesPlaceholder: Optional area, shelf, or shift reference
count.empty: No counts have been started for this site.
count.blindActiveHelp: Expected quantities and variances remain server-redacted until every line is submitted.

identities.serialHelp: Scan or enter one serial number per line. Count only unreserved stock at this site. Unknown units require a receipt.
identities.confirmEmpty: I confirm no units were found for {{name}}
identities.lotHelp: Count each batch separately, including expired or blocked stock. Enter 0 when none is found. Counting does not release a batch.
identities.noLots: No batches are registered. Receive any newly found batch before starting a new count.

replenishment.title: Replenishment suggestions
replenishment.description: Suggestions use this site's available stock plus open purchase-order quantities. Nothing is ordered automatically.
replenishment.empty: Every product with a configured minimum is covered at this site.
replenishment.explicitSubmitHelp: The draft does not update stock and cannot be received until a manager explicitly submits it from Purchase Orders.

blocked.catalog_parent: Choose an inventory-bearing variant instead of the catalog parent.

toast.successDetail: {{number}} is saved for review and has not been submitted.

server.INVENTORY_COUNT_IDENTITY_TRACKING_REQUIR: Tracking records must reconcile with site stock. Review the lot or serial records, or choose an individual variant, then start a new count.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_ALREADY_OPEN: One or more products already belong to an unfinished count at this site.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_STALE_VERSION: This count changed on another device. Reload it before continuing.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_INVALID_STATUS: This count is no longer in the required stage.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_INCOMPLETE: Record a quantity for every product before submitting the count.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_VALUE_CHANGED: Inventory value changed or this count has no verifiable cost basis. Reject it and start a new count.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_BALANCE_CHANGED: Stock changed after this count started. Start a fresh count before approving discrepancies.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_CATALOG_CHANGED: The product or its base unit changed after counting started. Review the catalog and start a fresh count.
server.ORDER_DRAFT_INVALID_STATUS: Only a purchase-order draft can be submitted.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_IDENTITY_CHANGED: Stock identities changed during the count. Reject it and start a new count.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Check each lot or serial number and its quantity. Use known identities from this site without duplicates; receive unknown stock first.
server.INVENTORY_COUNT_IDENTITY_LIMIT: This product has too many identities for one count. Contact support before adjusting stock.
